title: Lantern and Harbor
author: Rafael Whitlock
blurb: Lior Ishikawa, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
